title: ACTD: Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2608.29662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation effectively transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight student models. To enable knowledge transfer across disparate model families, researchers increasingly explore cross-tokenizer distillation. However, cross-tokenizer distillation remains challenging due to vocabulary and sequence misalignment, while approximate vocabulary alignment can introduce additional noise into distillation. To address these challenges, we propose Anchor-Based Cross-Tokenizer Distillation with Residual Regularization (ACTD). ACTD bridges structural heterogeneity through vocabulary and sequence alignment, while mitigating alignment noise via a novel anchor loss with residual regularization. We further extend this framework to a multi-teacher setting. Evaluated across five reasoning benchmarks with three distinct teacher models, ACTD achieves state-of-the-art performance. translated_title: ACTD：基于锚点的跨分词器蒸馏与残差正则化
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏能够有效地将大型语言模型的推理能力迁移到轻量级学生模型中。为了实现不同模型家族之间的知识迁移，研究者们越来越多地探索跨分词器蒸馏。然而，由于词表和序列的不对齐问题，跨分词器蒸馏仍然充满挑战，而近似的词表对齐会给蒸馏过程引入额外的噪声。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了基于锚点的跨分词器蒸馏与残差正则化方法（ACTD）。ACTD 通过词表和序列对齐来弥合结构异质性，同时利用一种新颖的带残差正则化的锚点损失来缓解对齐噪声。我们进一步将该框架扩展到多教师设置。在五个推理基准上使用三个不同的教师模型进行评估，ACTD 取得了最先进的性能。此外，其多教师扩展……
tldr: 该论文提出 ACTD 方法，通过词表与序列对齐结合带残差正则化的锚点损失，解决跨分词器蒸馏中的结构异质性与对齐噪声问题，并在多教师扩展下于五个推理基准上取得最先进性能。
